attack.failure: Repeated independent opening for each complete card requires twelve reads, three writes and one compile: sixteen action ticks before accounting for A invalidation. It cannot finish by boundary 11. A card written with old A also cannot survive compilation.
attack.invariant: Produce three distinct complete claim cards citing Ei plus current A, K and U, with application, model outcome, comparison and claim ceiling separate; compile by boundary 11.
attack.permitted_variable: Remove repeated independent source opening. Choose read order and retain immutable cached tokens, reading A only after its declared update.

budget_used.allocation: Before construction: allocate six reasoning slots to dependency removal, invariant retention, source/property mapping, one schedule construction, separating check and claim-limit recording. One candidate maximum; no revision or teacher state.
budget_used.limits: Word caps are not equal compute. This fresh fixed-method control has no practice-derived card, no historical retrieval and no empirical replay.

candidates.burden: Modeled operator burden: six source reads, three card writes and one compile, totaling ten actions. Retaining tokens and sequencing A displace repeated reopening; this is scheduling work, with no measured human review-time reduction.
candidates.defeat: The route fails if A is read before boundary 4, any write lacks its four current tokens, comparison or ceiling is omitted, or cached immutable tokens are unnecessarily discarded. Additional undeclared updates or a caching prohibition would invalidate the argument but are outside this fixture.
candidates.lineage: Initial fresh construction from the current packet and CORE:S01 only. No received candidate, teacher card, practice history or revision. Caching belongs to the supplied ordinary repertoire.
candidates.mechanism: Read each immutable source once, retain its exact token, and read A version 2 at tick 4 after the boundary-4 update. At boundary 6 all six tokens are current. Each subsequent write uses Ei plus the retained A, K and U. All cards therefore share current A and remain valid for compilation without reopening or rewriting.
candidates.prediction: Conditional finite-model prediction, awaiting root replay: writes complete at boundaries 7, 8 and 9; compile completes at boundary 10, one boundary before the deadline. This is a feasible counterexample to the necessity of repeated independent opening. It does not establish original caching, superiority over the matched old arm, or human benefit.

handoff.residue: The inconvenient timing detail is retained explicitly: A changes at boundary 4, invalidates old cached A, and makes every old-A card uncompilable. This route never reads or writes old A. E1/E2/E3 outcomes remain finite-model outputs; their comparison can tie. Human burden, adoption and learning remain unknown.
handoff.summary: Replay exactly read(K) at tick 0, read(U) at 1, read(E1) at 2, read(E2) at 3, read(A) at 4, read(E3) at 5, write("1") at 6, write("2") at 7, write("3") at 8, compile(null) at 9. Each action completes next boundary. Preserve three complete cards with Ei+A+K+U citations and separate application, outcome, comparison and ceiling. A read at tick 4 must return version 2. Expected completion is boundary 10, conditional on the stipulated rules. No repeated independent opening is restored; no external resource or assertion substitutes for a token.

limits: The action list is a constructed candidate; root performs replay and evaluation. No self-grading is supplied.
Academic rationale is not proof of this method; prior lineage already includes caching. The feasible schedule alone does not establish global or field originality.
All three cards retain applied synthetic method, finite-model output only, matched old arm possibly tied, and no human, field or global originality claim.
U01-U06 establish expressed preferences, not observed review time, adoption, learning or measured burden.
No four-summary substitution, omitted comparison/ceiling, new mechanical affordance, outside source or changed success criterion is used.
